lemmas.closed_form_parameterization: Every fixed parameter map is FO-uniform TC^0 by the audited closed-form lemma, hence available below the PNC^1 arithmetic layer.
lemmas.affine_lift: Represent h -> hA+b by the pair (A,b), equivalently by one homogeneous block matrix.
lemmas.associative_composition: (A,b) o (C,d) = (AC,bC+d); both parenthesizations of three transforms normalize to (ACE,bCE+dE+f).
lemmas.balanced_product: Compose n affine transforms with a balanced binary tree.
lemmas.fixed_layer_closure: A fixed number of heads and layers adds only a constant multiplicative depth factor and polynomial size.
lemmas.positive_gap_gate: The final strict positivity test is exactly the PNC^1 language predicate.

resource_recurrence.product_nodes: S(1)=0; every binary tree with n leaves has S(n)=n-1
resource_recurrence.per_product_depth: O(1), because M has fixed dimension
resource_recurrence.total_size: O(n) per prefix/output and polynomial for all n outputs

trusted_library_lemmas: Arithmetic closed form over Q is FO-uniform TC^0 (paper Lemma 1, citing Chiang et al.).
FO-uniform polynomial-size circuit families are closed under finite composition.
PNC^1 accepts by positivity of a GapNC^1 integer output.
